request.tone: gentle wonder and exploration with mild scariness and moderate tidal peril
request.note: catalog book read blind; no request text exists

pitch.hero: Maya, a girl exploring the sea caves under her aunt's lighthouse with Biscuit
pitch.want: to follow one of three echoing caves and find the wonder it hides
pitch.obstacle: the tide returns in about an hour and seals every cave mouth; slick rock, floods, sleeping bats
pitch.stake: a once-in-a-tide discovery against getting out dry and safe
pitch.ending_kind: a treasure or wonder brought home, or a safe retreat with a promise to return next low tide

maya.name: Maya
maya.role: protagonist; explorer of the sea caves
maya.want: to discover what the echoing caves hide before the tide comes back
maya.voice: close third present; curious, careful, wonder-struck, weighs risk against the tide

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.want: to sniff out every passage and stay close to Maya
biscuit.voice: wordless; tail wags, whines, sniffs and one proud bark

aunt.name: Maya's aunt
aunt.want: unstated; knows where Maya is exploring

truth.statement: Under the lighthouse, three echoing sea caves open as the tide goes out, and Maya has about an hour before the sea seals them. The humming cave hides a crystal grotto, a singing chamber and a lost ship's bell; the dripping cave hides a black underground lake and a hidden tide-pool; the whispering cave hides a bat roost under a meadow skylight and a century-old smuggler's cache. Turning back at any risk point always gets Maya and Biscuit out safely.
truth.question: What do the three echoing caves hide, and what can Maya find before the tide returns?

maya_hero.text: Maya is the girl exploring the sea caves under the lighthouse rocks.

biscuit_with_maya.text: Biscuit, Maya's four-legged companion with a wagging tail, comes into the caves with her.

lighthouse_above_cove.text: A lighthouse stands on the rocks above the cove and its sea caves.

aunt_knows_exploring.text: Maya's aunt knows Maya and Biscuit are exploring the cove until the tide turns.

tide_going_out.text: The tide is pulling back from the sea caves as Maya arrives.

three_openings.text: Three dark cave openings wait in the cliff, cool air breathing out of each.

three_sounds.text: Each mouth has its own sound: the left hums warm and low, the right drips slow and steady, the one straight ahead almost whispers.

tide_deadline.text: Maya has about an hour before the sea comes back and seals every cave mouth shut.

maya_has_torch.text: Maya carries a torch and switches it on.

maya_has_notebook.text: Maya has a notebook in her pocket.

left_tunnel_humming.text: The left passage narrows into a low tunnel that hums like one held note.

glow_rustle_ahead.text: Past a bend in the humming tunnel a soft light glows and a faint rustle like wind through paper drifts back.

left_split.text: The humming tunnel splits: one way a wall glitters with tiny specks, the other way the hum grows warmer like a murmuring voice.

quartz_wall.text: The glittering wall is studded with tiny bits of quartz that throw back torchlight.

slope_to_crack.text: Beside the glittering wall the floor slopes down toward a narrow crack breathing cold air.

round_room.text: The sloping floor opens into a small, round, quiet room where water drips.

blue_crack.text: A crack in the round room's wall glows with soft blue light like trapped moonlight.

crack_squeezable.text: The glowing crack is narrow, but Maya could just squeeze through sideways.

water_pooling_left.text: Cold water seeping from deep in the rock pools around Maya's boots at the glowing crack.

crack_left_unentered.text: Maya turns back and leaves the glowing crack unexplored for another low tide.

sea_halfway_up.text: By the time Maya splashes back to the cave mouth the sea has crept halfway up the rocks.

through_crack.text: Maya and Biscuit squeeze through the glowing crack into open space.

shimmering_room_ahead.text: Beyond the crack the blue glow fills a wide shimmering room.

crystal_grotto.text: The shimmering room is a crystal grotto whose walls hold glowing blue crystals.

loose_crystal.text: One loose glowing crystal wobbles in its socket at Maya's eye level.

humming_archway.text: A rounded archway deeper in the grotto hums with a low sound.

maya_has_crystal.text: Maya eases the loose crystal free and holds it, cool, heavy and glowing.

crystal_passage_up.text: The crystal's light reveals a low passage curving upward toward the lighthouse.

passage_new_to_maya.text: Maya had not seen the low passage before the crystal lit it.

knew_crystal_passage.text: Maya already knew of the low passage up from the grotto.

door_behind_lighthouse.text: A narrow stone stair from the grotto ends at a little wooden door tucked behind the old lighthouse.

out_at_evening.text: Maya comes out of the caves in the evening light.

ribbed_shell_walls.text: Past the archway, smooth ribbed walls curve overhead like the inside of a great shell.

stone_shaped_for_sound.text: The ribbed stone seems shaped on purpose, built to carry sound.

ringing_chamber.text: The ribbed walls open into a great round chamber where every drip and step rings back like a choir.

chamber_sings.text: When Maya sings one note, the round chamber sings it back, layered and shimmering.

keepers_secret_belief.text: Maya thinks only the lighthouse keepers of long ago ever knew of the chamber that sings.

murmur_is_ringing.text: The warm murmur is not wind but a low, even ringing, like a bell struck far below.

murmur_is_wind.text: The warm murmur in the left tunnel is wind.

chamber_below.text: The passage steepens over a chamber below where pale light leaks up, something metal flashes, and a deep chime rises.

rope_ladder.text: An old rope ladder, left long ago, hangs down into the chiming chamber and holds firm when tugged.

chime_left_unvisited.text: Maya climbs back up and leaves the chiming chamber for a safer day.

reached_bell.text: Maya climbs down the rope ladder to the chamber floor.

ships_bell.text: At the bottom hangs a huge old ship's bell, green with age, rung softly by drips from the ceiling.

ship_lost_100y.text: Letters cast in the bell's lip spell the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago.

lantern_and_rope.text: On a dry ledge behind the bell sit a rusted lantern and a coil of good rope, left long ago.

lantern_candle_stub.text: The rusted lantern still holds a stub of old candle.

ship_name_in_notebook.text: Maya copies the lost ship's name into her notebook.

maya_has_lantern_rope.text: Maya takes the old lantern and the coil of rope with her.

maya_home_near_sea.text: Maya's home is near the sea where the lost ship lies.

right_trickle.text: The right-hand dripping passage has wet black walls, cold salty air, and a thin trickle of water running deeper.

right_split.text: The trickle leads to a split: a slow hollow lapping one way, a sharp briny smell from a low narrow side-tunnel the other.

pebble_cavern.text: Toward the lapping, the floor turns to wet smooth pebbles and the ceiling lifts out of torch reach.

black_lake.text: Past a rock shelf stretches black, still water out of sight; the lapping is that water at the shelf's edge.

weed_slick_shelf.text: The rock shelf narrows ahead, slick and green with weed, above a vast underground lake.

lake_shore_below.text: Below the slippery shelf lies the lake's pale shore.

lake_left_unvisited.text: Maya backs off the slippery shelf and leaves the black lake for another day.

on_gravel_shore.text: Maya climbs down safely to a shore of pale smooth gravel beside the lake.

dark_shape_on_shore.text: Something long and dark rests half out of the water on the gravel shore.

rowboat.text: The dark shape is an old wooden rowboat, cracked in places but still whole and solid.

glowing_shallows.text: Further along the shore, the shallow water glows faintly as if lit from beneath.

boat_floats.text: The rowboat's oars are still lashed inside, and once emptied of rainwater it floats steady.

chimney_to_dunes.text: Across the lake a stone chimney lets daylight through and leads up into dune grass and open sky.

first_across_belief.text: Maya is certain they are the first people in a lifetime to cross the hidden lake.

glowing_shells.text: Thousands of tiny pale shells carpet the shallows and glow wherever they are stirred.

bright_opening.text: The glowing shallows lead toward a low, bright opening in the cave wall.

glowing_islet.text: The shells lead to a tiny islet of white sand lit by a narrow shaft of open sky, ringed by glowing water.

maya_has_shells.text: Maya tucks a few pale shells into her pocket to take home.

islet_kept_secret.text: Maya promises to keep the shining islet a secret.

briny_crawl.text: The briny side-tunnel is so tight and low that Maya must crouch and crawl.

biscuit_small.text: Biscuit is small enough to trot where Maya must crawl.

pale_light_ahead.text: A paler light glows faintly ahead through the narrow briny tunnel.

clear_channel.text: The tunnel widens under hanging weed, and a shallow channel of clear seawater runs toward a rounded chamber.

weed_curtain.text: The channel ends at a curtain of hanging weed with bright watery light beyond.

channel_flooding.text: Behind Maya the channel is already filling with the tide, water rising fast around her ankles.

pool_left_unentered.text: Maya hurries back and never goes through the weed curtain this tide.

hidden_tide_pool.text: Beyond the weed curtain is a bright hidden tide-pool, clear as air, lit from above, with anemones and silver fish.

rare_starfish.text: A rare cushion starfish glows deep orange in one corner of the tide-pool.

never_seen_starfish.text: Maya has never seen anything like the cushion starfish before.

seen_starfish_before.text: Maya has seen a cushion starfish like this one before.

crab_tracks_basin.text: Small crab tracks lead toward a deeper, darker basin in the rock.

starfish_sketched.text: Maya sketches the starfish carefully in her notebook.

starfish_left_in_place.text: Maya leaves the starfish where it clings to the rock.

starfish_taken.text: Maya takes the cushion starfish with her.

rockpool_club.text: Maya belongs to a rockpool club back home.

pale_thing_in_basin.text: Something smooth and pale lies half-buried in sand at the bottom of the murky green basin.

maya_has_spiral_shell.text: Maya lifts out a perfect spiral shell as big as her two hands, pearled pink inside.

whisper_is_draft.text: The whispering echo is only a draft of air sighing over cold stone.

dark_split.text: The dark passage forks: a papery squeaking and flutter one way, a slow creak of old wood and a glint of rusted iron the other.

roosting_shapes.text: Hundreds of small folded shapes hang twitching from a high ceiling.

bat_roost.text: The shapes are hundreds of sleeping bats roosting in a warm, earthy, vaulted chamber.

grey_light_roof.text: A faint circle of grey light shows through a narrow gap high in the roost's roof.

shaft_under_roost.text: The grey light comes down a narrow shaft that might lead out, reached only by crossing beneath the roost.

never_touch_bats.text: The bats are wild animals, and Maya knows she must never touch them.

roost_left_uncrossed.text: Maya backs away and does not cross under the roost.

crossed_roost.text: Maya and Biscuit cross the roost floor beneath the bats.

rock_stair.text: Beneath the grey shaft, fallen rock forms a rough staircase climbing toward daylight.

old_carving.text: Halfway up the rock stair, an old carved arrow and faded initials show someone climbed it long before.

mossy_funnel.text: The rock stair narrows into a damp mossy funnel smelling of grass.

meadow_hole.text: The funnel comes out through a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow above the lighthouse.

colony_unnoticed.text: Nobody in years seems to have noticed the bat colony living below the meadow.

plank_door.text: Broken barrel staves lie scattered by a leaning door of grey planks with rusted nails, wedged into a side-cave.

hidden_hollow.text: Behind the plank door is a dry hollow walled off by hand long ago as a hiding place, crowded with stacked crates.

smuggler_cache.text: The hollow is an old smuggler's cache forgotten for a hundred years.

cache_flooding.text: With the tide turning, water creeps across the cache floor.

cache_left_unopened.text: Maya leaves the cache's crates unopened for a drier day.

two_boxes.text: Most crates have rotted, but two smaller, whole boxes sit on a dry stone shelf.

brass_compass.text: The first box holds a green-crusted brass compass.

rattling_box.text: The second box is heavier and rattles like a handful of loose coins.

carry_only_one.text: Maya can carry only one box out before the tide catches up.

compass_works.text: Wiped clean, the compass needle still swings true.

silver_coins.text: The heavy box is full of blackened old silver coins stamped faintly with strange faces.

coins_uncounted.text: Maya does not stop to count the coins.

maya_has_coins.text: Maya carries the whole heavy box of coins out of the cave.

safe_out.text: Maya and Biscuit reach the cave mouth and daylight safely.

n_open.event: Maya and Biscuit slip under the lighthouse rocks as the tide goes out; three cave mouths each echo a different sound.

n_start.event: Maya checks the tide line, has about an hour, switches on her torch, checks her notebook, and picks a sound.

la_tunnel.event: The left passage becomes a low humming tunnel; a glow and a papery rustle wait past a bend.

la_fork.event: The humming tunnel splits between a glittering wall and a warmer murmur.

la_glitter.event: The glittering wall is quartz; the floor slopes down to a cold-breathing crack.

la_glitter2.event: The slope opens into a round room where a crack glows blue.

la_grotto_app.event: Maya could squeeze through the glowing crack, but cold water is pooling at her boots.

la_retreat_pool.event: Maya carries Biscuit back through rising water and reaches daylight as the sea climbs the rocks.

la_squeeze.event: Maya and Biscuit squeeze through the crack toward a wide shimmering room.

la_grotto.event: The room is a crystal grotto with a loose crystal at eye level and a humming archway.

la_crystal_take.event: Maya takes the loose crystal, and its light shows a hidden passage up toward the lighthouse.

la_crystal_out.event: The crystal lights a stair to a door behind the lighthouse; Maya steps out at evening holding a real cave crystal.

la_crystal_deeper.event: Through the archway the hum swells to a chord between ribbed, shell-like walls shaped to carry sound.

la_song_app.event: The ribbed walls open into a vast round chamber where every sound rings back like a choir.

la_song.event: Maya sings a note and the chamber sings it back; she believes only old lighthouse keepers knew of it.

la_hum.event: The warm murmur turns out to be a ringing like a bell far below.

la_hum2.event: The passage steepens over a chamber below where pale light, a metal flash and a deep chime rise.

la_bell_app.event: An old rope ladder hangs into the chiming chamber, but time is short.

la_hum_back.event: Maya leaves the ladder and the chime for a safer day and reaches the cave mouth as the sea starts to lap.

la_bell.event: At the bottom of the ladder hangs a huge green ship's bell rung by dripping water.

la_bell2.event: The bell bears the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago; a lantern and rope sit on a ledge behind it.

la_bell3.event: Maya copies the ship's name into her notebook and gathers the lantern and rope.

la_bell4.event: Maya climbs out with the name, lantern and rope at golden evening, ready to tell the town about the lost ship's bell.

ra_drip.event: The right passage has wet black walls, cold salt air and a trickle of water leading deeper.

ra_fork.event: The trickle reaches a split between hollow lapping water and a briny side-tunnel.

ra_lake_way.event: Toward the lapping, the floor turns to pebbles and the ceiling lifts away.

ra_lake2.event: A rock shelf borders black still water; the lapping is the lake itself.

ra_lake_app.event: The shelf narrows, weed-slick, above the vast lake; climb down to its shore or back off.

ra_lake_back.event: Maya coaxes Biscuit back off the shelf and retraces the dripping passage to daylight.

ra_descend.event: Maya climbs down to a pale gravel shore where a long dark shape lies half out of the water.

ra_lakeshore.event: The shape is an old rowboat; further along, the shallows glow.

ra_boat.event: The rowboat still has its oars, floats once emptied, and Biscuit hops in.

ra_row.event: Maya rows across the hidden lake and climbs a stone chimney out into dune grass.

ra_wade.event: The shallows are carpeted with glowing shells that lead toward a bright opening.

ra_islet.event: The shells lead to a sky-lit islet; Maya pockets a few shells and vows to keep the place secret.

ra_pool_way.event: Maya crawls through the tight briny tunnel after Biscuit toward a pale light.

ra_pool2.event: The tunnel widens under hanging weed, with a clear seawater channel running toward a chamber.

ra_pool_app.event: A weed curtain hides bright light ahead while the channel behind floods with the tide.

ra_pool_back.event: Maya carries Biscuit back through the rising channel and bursts out as the sea pours in.

ra_pool_enter.event: Through the weed lies a hidden tide-pool, clear and sunlit, full of anemones and fish.

ra_pool_chamber.event: A rare orange cushion starfish glows in one corner; crab tracks lead to a darker basin.

ra_starfish.event: Maya sketches the starfish in her notebook, leaves it on the rock, and slips out.

ra_starfish2.event: Maya leaves with her sketches, sure her rockpool club will believe her only when they see them.

ra_pool_deep.event: In the murky green basin something smooth and pale lies half-buried; Maya reaches in.

ra_pool_deep2.event: Maya lifts out a great pink-pearled spiral shell and carries it into daylight.

da_dark.event: Maya steps down the darkest passage; the whisper is only a draft of air.

da_fork.event: The dark passage forks between a squeaking flutter and creaking old wood.

da_bat_way.event: Toward the squeaking, hundreds of small folded shapes hang from a high ceiling.

da_bat2.event: The shapes are hundreds of sleeping bats; grey light shows through a gap high in the roof.

da_bat_app.event: The grey light is a shaft that may lead out, but reaching it means crossing beneath the roost.

da_bat_back.event: Maya backs away, leaves the bats sleeping, reaches daylight, and plans to ask her aunt about them.

da_bat_enter.event: Maya and Biscuit cross beneath the roost without waking a bat and find a fallen-rock stair under the shaft.

da_roost.event: Halfway up the rock stair Maya finds an old carved arrow and faded initials.

da_roost2.event: The stair narrows into a mossy funnel; Maya boosts Biscuit up and climbs toward green light.

da_skylight.event: Maya climbs out of a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow, a forgotten way into the caves above an unnoticed bat colony.

da_cache_way.event: Toward the creaking, barrel staves lead to a leaning plank door in a side-cave.

da_cache2.event: The door opens on a hand-walled hiding hollow crowded with stacked crates.

da_cache_app.event: It is a century-old smuggler's cache, and tide water is already creeping across its floor.

da_cache_back.event: Maya marks the cache in her memory and beats the tide out, planning to return on a drier day.

da_cache_enter.event: Most crates have rotted, but two whole boxes sit on a dry shelf.

da_cache_room.event: One box holds a brass compass, the other rattles like coins; Maya can carry only one before the tide.

da_compass.event: Maya wipes the compass, its needle still true, and follows Biscuit out ahead of the tide.

da_compass2.event: Biscuit leads Maya out as the sea rushes in; she holds a real smuggler's compass.

da_coins.event: The box is full of blackened silver coins; Maya does not stop to count them and carries the box out.

da_coins2.event: Maya lugs the coin box to daylight ahead of the tide and pictures a museum displaying her find.

c_open.intent: listen to the three echoes before choosing

c_left.cost: gives up the dripping and whispering caves

c_right.cost: gives up the humming and whispering caves

c_down.cost: gives up the humming and dripping caves

c_glitter.intent: see what glitters in the wall
c_glitter.cost: gives up the warm murmur route

c_hum.cost: gives up the glittering wall route

c_la_slope.intent: follow the slope toward the cold crack

c_squeeze.intent: push through to the glow before the water rises
c_squeeze.cost: risks the rising water; gives up a dry retreat

c_retreat.intent: get out while the way is dry
c_retreat.cost: gives up the glowing room beyond the crack

c_take.intent: take a crystal as a keepsake

c_bell.intent: climb down the old ladder to the chime
c_bell.cost: uses up scarce time before the tide

c_humback.intent: head back while there is time
c_humback.cost: gives up whatever is chiming below

c_la_bell2.intent: look closely at the great bell

c_la_bell3.intent: read the name and check the ledge

c_pool.cost: gives up the lapping water route

c_ra_shelf.intent: see how far the shelf runs

c_descend.cost: risks a fall on the slick rock

c_enter.intent: see the light beyond the weed

c_poolback.intent: get out before the channel floods
c_poolback.cost: gives up what lies beyond the weed curtain

c_deep.cost: gives up a close look at the starfish

c_ra_reach.intent: reach for what gleams in the basin

c_da_fork.intent: feel the way down in the dark

c_bat.cost: gives up the creaking wood route

c_batback.cost: gives up the shaft and its way out

c_cacheenter.cost: spends time as the tide comes in

c_coins.cost: gives up the compass; a heavy load to carry

la_retreat_pool.gift: the relief of a safe, laughing escape and a promise to come back next low tide

la_crystal_out.gift: a glowing cave crystal carried home through a secret stair behind the lighthouse

la_song.gift: a chamber that sings Maya's note back to her, a secret of the old keepers

la_hum_back.gift: a safe, unhurried return and a chime left waiting for the next visit

la_bell4.gift: a lost ship's bell, its name in her notebook, and a story for the whole town

ra_lake_back.gift: the good sense to back off slick rock; the black lake waits for another day

ra_row.gift: rowing across a hidden lake and climbing out into open sky

ra_islet.gift: a secret glowing islet and a pocketful of shining shells

ra_pool_back.gift: a dash to beat the flooding channel and a reason to try again

ra_starfish2.gift: a careful sketch of a rare starfish, left alive where it lives

ra_pool_deep2.gift: a great pink spiral shell, the finest thing Maya has ever found

da_bat_back.gift: the kind choice to let wild bats sleep, and a question for her aunt

da_skylight.gift: a forgotten skylight route and an unnoticed bat colony under the meadow

da_cache_back.gift: a smuggler's cache remembered for a drier day

da_compass2.gift: a smuggler's compass whose needle still finds north

da_coins2.gift: a box of smugglers' silver and a dream of her name in a museum

notes: Book declares no variables, so threads is empty; the graph is a pure time-cave tree, every node reached by exactly one route.

Opposite facts such as knew_crystal_passage, murmur_is_wind, seen_starfish_before, starfish_taken, bats_woken and coins_counted are declared only as the contradiction partners of negatives the prose states; no passage asserts them.
Turn-back endings are given a not-entered fact contradicting the forward route's entry fact, since the two routes are mutually exclusive.
